title: The Singer conjecture in dimension four

abstractEnglish: We prove the four-dimensional Singer conjecture: the L2-Betti numbers of the universal cover of a closed connected aspherical topological four-manifold vanish outside degree two. More generally, the same vanishing holds for finite connected aspherical integral Poincaré complexes of formal dimension four, including nonorientable ones.
titleEn: The Singer conjecture in dimension four

details.overview: 该稿件研究四维Singer猜想。作者声称证明：闭连通非球面拓扑四维流形万有覆叠的L²-Betti数在二次以外消失。摘要进一步表示，同样的消失结论对形式维数为四的有限连通非球面整Poincaré复形成立，包括不可定向情形。若成立，这将把Singer猜想推进到四维，并推广到更一般的Poincaré复形。
keyPoints: 声称证明四维Singer猜想：L²-Betti数在二次以外消失
结论推广到形式维数四的有限连通非球面整Poincaré复形
